user_prompt: Create a publication-quality French medical teaching schematic, horizontal 16:9. Clean vector histology plate on warm ivory background, colorblind-safe teal, blue, orange and charcoal palette, precise sans-serif typography, no logo, no watermark, not photorealistic. Two equal panels. Left title: Prostate bénigne; show organized acini with Lumière, Cellules luminales, Couche basale and Stroma, plus short label Architecture conservée. Right title: Adénocarcinome infiltrant; show crowded irregular small glands infiltrating stroma, no represented basal layer, plus short label Infiltration. Use a small legend and clear arrows. Integrated main title exactly: Du tissu organisé à l’infiltration tumorale. Keep all French text sparse, correct and legible; this is conceptual, not a diagnostic slide.

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements

IMPORTANT - NO FIGURE NUMBERS:
- Do NOT include "Figure 1:", "Fig. 1", or any figure numbering in the image
- Do NOT add captions or titles like "Figure: ..." at the top or bottom
- Figure numbers and captions are added separately in the document/LaTeX
- The diagram should contain only the visual content itself

iterations.critique:
SCORE: 7.4

STRENGTHS:
- Outstanding graphic quality featuring clean vector lines, an elegant warm ivory background, and a harmonious colorblind-safe palette.
- Excellent layout and visual hierarchy, featuring exact main title text ("Du tissu organisé à l’infiltration tumorale"), clear panel division, precise callout arrows, and neat typography.

ISSUES:
- Scientific inaccuracy & prompt non-compliance: The right panel ("Adénocarcinome infiltrant") depicts an orange outer layer around the tumor glands. In prostate pathology, invasive adenocarcinoma is defined by the complete loss of the basal cell layer (Couche basale), which was also explicitly requested in the prompt ("no represented basal layer").
- Legend alignment: Because the legend identifies the orange color as "Couche basale", displaying orange outlines around the malignant glands on the right panel creates confusion for medical teaching.

VERDICT: NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT
